name: Explosion of Riches
oracle_text: Draw a card, then each other player may draw a card. Whenever a card is drawn this way, Explosion of Riches deals 5 damage to target opponent chosen at random from among your opponents.
blocked_sentences: Draw a card, then each other player may draw a card. Whenever a card is drawn this way, Explosion of Riches deals 5 damage to target opponent chosen at random from among your opponents.

needs.what: allow a target spec's selector `random: true` on a reflexive (`kind: "reflexive"`) ability, so a `reflexive_trigger` fired after each card drawn by this spell (your draw, then each other player's `may` draw inside `for_each_player`) puts an ability on the stack whose one player target -- an opponent -- is drawn by `stack._random_trigger_targets`, which already serves reflexive triggers at runtime
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `choose_player` with `random: true` draws a seat but is a choice, not a target: it ignores hexproof and shroud and is never re-checked, so it is a different card from 'target opponent chosen at random'. The random-target path refuses `random` unless `on_trigger`, which `cards/loader/__init__.py::_compile_targets` sets only for TRIGGERED and CHAPTER abilities, not REFLEXIVE
